'''Eaters''' were [[Dinosaur/Legends|dinosaur]]-like predators native to [[Abonshee|Masterhome]], similar to [[tyrannosaur]]s. They stood three [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall at the shoulder, with thick, muscular torsos, thick skin, long legs, and immense teeth. Eaters were warm [[Blood/Legends|blooded]] and covered in [[Hair/Legends|fur]]. Their favorite prey were [[Griff (creature)|griffs]].<ref name="Godking" />
